parts.text:
There are **6 stadiums** that did not host any concert in 2014:

| # | Stadium Name |
|---|---|
| 1 | Bayview Stadium |
| 2 | Hampden Park |
| 3 | Forthbank Stadium |
| 4 | Gayfield Park |
| 5 | Recreation Park |
| 6 | Balmoor |

These stadiums had no concerts scheduled in the year 2014 based on the concert records.
